candidate_wazuh_rule.description: Powershell.exe spawned a powershell process which executed a base64 encoded command

executed_behaviors: The launcher PowerShell constructs a UTF-16LE Base64 command string.
The launcher PowerShell creates one child powershell.exe process with -EncodedCommand.
The child command writes a run-specific result file.
findstr.exe queries the run identifier in the result file.
expected_artifacts: Result query stdout and stderr files
explicit_non_actions: No encoded content is downloaded from a network location.
No external process payload is written or launched.
No persistence object or autorun location is created.
No credential, account, firewall, Defender, audit or Wazuh setting is accessed or modified.

negative_behavior_catalog.behavior: No content is downloaded from a network location.
No external process payload is written or launched.
No persistence object or autorun location is created.
No credential or account information is accessed or modified.
No firewall, Defender, audit or Wazuh security-control setting is modified.

causal_boundaries: The encoded command only writes the run-specific result file.
The child process exit code and result file are separate completion evidence.
The later findstr.exe process is a query and is not part of the encoded child command.
preferred_anchor: A current-RUN wazuh-alerts-* event for rule 92057 with rule.id, rule.level and rule.description present.
correlation_requirements: Correlate the alert child PID or ProcessGuid to the launcher parent PID or ParentProcessGuid.
Correlate the child process to the run-specific result file and runtime time window.
known_telemetry_gaps: The RUN ID is inside the encoded command content, so the alert may require PID or ProcessGuid correlation to the parent and file event.
FileCreate visibility depends on the active Sysmon filter and Wazuh forwarding.
